title: 预警新奥尔良二级飓风：实际登陆北卡仅一级，风暴预测为何偏差
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Craig Allen, he was on earlier, but we need an update.
segments.zh: 克雷格·艾伦之前来过，但我们需要最新情况。

segments.en: Meteorologist Bloomberg Surveillance, a lack of hysteria in order.
segments.zh: 彭博监测气象学家，不必恐慌。

segments.en: Craig, you said this is going to become a hurricane.
segments.zh: 克雷格，你说这会变成飓风。

segments.en: Does it do that out in the water before it hits New Orleans?
segments.zh: 它会在海上变成飓风再袭击新奥尔良吗？

segments.en: Yes, it does. It'll be developing over the water because a hurricane needs the very warm, moist tropical water.
segments.zh: 是的，它会在水面上发展，因为飓风需要非常温暖潮湿的热带水域。

segments.en: And as you mentioned in the last time, we spoke is that the water temperatures down there in the Gulf are around 90 degrees.
segments.zh: 正如你上次提到的，墨西哥湾的水温大约在90度。

segments.en: That is perfect for rapid intensification of a tropical system.
segments.zh: 这非常适合热带系统的快速增强。

segments.en: So with that in mind, it will likely become a category one or a category two, maybe even a low category three,
segments.zh: 因此，它可能会变成一级或二级飓风，甚至可能是低级三级，

segments.en: very rapidly over the next 24 to 48 hours, Tom.
segments.zh: 在接下来的24到48小时内非常迅速地增强，汤姆。

segments.en: And it definitely will be a hurricane by the time it reaches the coastline.
segments.zh: 当它到达海岸线时，肯定已经是飓风了。

segments.en: Like I said, I think it could easily reach hurricane status within the next 24 hours or so.
segments.zh: 如我所说，我认为它很可能在未来24小时左右达到飓风级别。

segments.en: I just have to say, Craig, in another lifetime, I used to toss to you to do the weather at CBS local here in New York.
segments.zh: 克雷格，我得说，以前我常把天气播报交给你，在纽约CBS本地台。

segments.en: So it's lovely to be on with you. And I said to say that it's so good to see you again, and to chat with you.
segments.zh: 很高兴能和你一起做节目。我说过，很高兴再次见到你，和你聊天。

segments.en: Same here, Chris, out there. Yeah, same here. That was the Douglas Edwards, right?
segments.zh: 我也一样，克里斯。是的，我也一样。那是道格拉斯·爱德华兹，对吧？
道格拉斯·爱德华兹。CBS。是的。

segments.en: Yeah, OK. OK. No. No, no, no, no.
What happens with this storm? Do that too. Like, yeah.
segments.zh: 这场风暴会怎样？也做那个。就像，是的。
